snapshot_policy.rationale: Freeze only the bounded source support needed to replay current claims; preserve DOI/URL/version provenance instead of copying full copyrighted source documents.
snapshot_policy.future_change_rule: Any changed source wording after cutoff requires a new snapshot revision.

snapshots.title: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics — Nutrition Assessment
snapshots.locator: Nutrition Assessment / Nutrition Assessment Critical Thinking
normalized_support: Nutrition Assessment is the first Nutrition Care Process step and its collected data support later NCP steps.
Assessment uses multiple domains, including food/nutrition history, anthropometrics, biochemical/tests, physical findings and client history.
Critical thinking includes identifying needs for additional information and obtaining/requesting relevant data.

snapshots.title: 2025 AHA/ACC Multisociety High Blood Pressure Guideline — current corrected online version
snapshots.locator: current online guideline: BP classification + treatment threshold/risk sections
normalized_support: Current corrected guideline classifies stage 1 hypertension as systolic 130–139 or diastolic 80–89 mmHg.
Management recommendations use average BP and cardiovascular/clinical-risk context rather than a single isolated reading.

snapshots.title: American Heart Association — Home Blood Pressure Monitoring
snapshots.locator: Who should monitor / measurement instructions / high reading / journal sections
normalized_support: Repeated measurements and correct technique are part of BP interpretation.
Home monitoring can aid confirmation, while a medical professional confirms diagnosis.
A single high reading should not be treated as a complete longitudinal BP picture.

snapshots.title: USPSTF — Healthy Diet and Physical Activity Counseling in Adults With CVD Risk Factors
snapshots.locator: Final Recommendation Statement / Recommendation Summary / Clinician Summary
normalized_support: The recommendation applies to adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors and recommends offering or referring them for behavioral counseling.
Applicability requires risk-factor context; the topic is under update at the cutoff.

snapshots.title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025–2030
normalized_support: The 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines provide general nutrition guidance to meet nutrient needs, promote health and prevent disease.
This is broad population guidance rather than a case-specific individualized assessment protocol.

snapshots.title: USPSTF — Behavioral Weight Loss Interventions in Adults
normalized_support: USPSTF recommends intensive multicomponent behavioral interventions for adults with BMI 30 or higher.
The topic is under update at the cutoff.

copyright_boundary: No full copyrighted source document is stored; snapshots contain bounded normalized support plus stable source identity and locator.
